data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'aurum' meaning 'gold'. This name was given to children born with golden-hued hair or to those considered precious and valuable. The name Aurita carries the meaning “Golden One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aurita usually hope their child will grow to embody golden one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Radiating light and warmth like the sun.
data.etymology: Aurita belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Golden One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aurita total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

This would have added a layer of prestige and admiration to the bearer in Christian societies where Latin names were prevalent.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Aurita lies in its association with the precious metal gold, which in Christianity represents the divine and eternal. Gold appears frequently in religious art, symbolizing the worth and value of souls, kingship, and piety. In the Bible, gold is used to represent God's divine wisdom and promise. Naming a child Aurita could serve as a reminder of their intrinsic spiritual value and eternal potential.
